identity.scenario: Same current frozen production harness plus post-loop normalized semantic observations; four alternating process pairs

boundaries: Node/jsdom, not browser FPS/layout/paint/GPU or real image/audio decode.
Same fixed workload and requested250us CPU/32KiB allocation sampling; CPU and heap collected in separate passes.
CPU counts use native samples, not milliseconds; actual sampling interval and collector overhead vary.
Sampled allocated bytes include collected objects; not retained heap/RSS. Inclusive rows overlap.
Unprofiled operation timings are from four fresh fork-process runs per variant, alternating order; 3 warmups+15samples per operation per run.
Semantic observations are taken after measured loops and profile windows; whitespace-only text and attribute/class/style order normalized; added hand group role+label disclosed separately.

limitations: Sampled allocation bytes are an estimate from V8's sampling heap profiler, not the exact retained heap or process RSS.
Only allocations sampled by V8 are reported; small or short-lived allocations may be underrepresented.
Source-map resolution is not applied by this extractor.
V8 line and column coordinates are zero-based; -1 means unavailable.
1 allocation samples (32800 estimated bytes) reference nodes absent from the native call tree; their frame attribution is unavailable and coverage is incomplete.

corrections: live stage token and first-child ownership
isolated QA host disabled controls reapplication

focusedIdle.scope: Exact v4: steady unchanged render, 28 cards and 4 foes, each process 30 warm + 150 samples; three alternating pairs; same unchanged idle harness as v3, fresh data

hotspots.scope: Exact v4 high mixed workload. Inclusive values overlap; recursive patchNode must not be summed with show/render. Zero means no observed row, not no work. CPU counts are native samples; heap bytes are sampled allocation estimates.

releaseBoundaries: Local CPU/allocation/correctness evidence only; release decision belongs to parent workflow.
Short mixed-context and steady idle metrics are separately preserved; v3 metrics are not reused.
No browser FPS/layout/paint/GPU/decode validation, no browser access retry or bypass.
No main checkout mutation, build, push or deployment performed by this measurement task.
